messages.security.plugin.consent.title: This plugin asks for:
messages.security.plugin.consent.secret.label: Read stored secrets
messages.security.plugin.consent.secret.detail: The plugin can ask the vault for connection passwords and key passphrases.
messages.security.plugin.consent.auth.label: Act as an authentication provider
messages.security.plugin.consent.auth.detail: The plugin can answer SSH authentication challenges on your behalf.
messages.security.plugin.consent.tunnel.label: Act as a tunnel provider
messages.security.plugin.consent.tunnel.detail: The plugin can carry session traffic, and therefore see it.
messages.security.plugin.consent.multiSession.det: One plugin process serves every session, so a fault in it affects all of them.
messages.security.plugin.consent.network.label: Open arbitrary network connections
messages.security.plugin.consent.network.detail: The plugin is not restricted to the hosts it declared. It can reach any address.
messages.security.plugin.consent.exec.label: Run commands over the exec channel
messages.security.plugin.consent.exec.detail: The plugin can execute commands on the remote host.
messages.security.plugin.warning.untrustedSignatu: This plugin is signed by a key you do not trust.

messages.security.plugin.warning.noChecksum: No checksum accompanies this plugin, so its files cannot be verified.
messages.security.plugin.warning.untrustedSource: This repository is not marked as trusted.
messages.security.plugin.warning.localInstall: Installing from a folder or bundle skips every source check: nothing verifies where these files came from. Install only plugins you built yourself or obtained from someone you trust.

messages.security.plugin.trust.allowUnsandboxed: Start a plugin unconfined if its sandbox cannot be applied
messages.security.plugin.trust.allowUnsandboxed.h: Off by default. When your system can isolate a plugin and the attempt fails, the plugin does not start — turning this on lets it run with your full access instead, and its row will say "not sandboxed". It has no effect where the system cannot isolate plugins at all.
